facts.fact: The correct sequence when building the shim pack is: thick spacer first, then shims on top of it, and then the thin spacer — not the other way around.

facts.fact: A common assembly error is installing the thin spacer before the shims instead of placing the thick spacer down first; the operator flags this happens more often than not with new assemblers.
